title: Near-Optimal Bell Nonlocality with GKP and Entangled Cat States
summary: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states are widely studied as a bosonic encoding for fault-tolerant quantum computing because small displacement errors can be identified and corrected through syndrome measurements. However, fault-tolerant operation requires substantially greater GKP squeezing than is currently available in optical platforms. It is therefore important to identify quantum-information tasks that can be realised with finite-squeezing GKP states.
